blocks.text: Lewis theory ke mutabiq ionic bond tab banta hai jab kam ionization energy wala atom apne electrons poore ke poore zyada electron affinity wale atom ko de deta hai (complete transfer). Na atom (₁₁Na = 2, 8, 1) apna sab se bahar wala ek electron kho kar Na⁺ (2, 8) ion banata hai; is ki configuration ₁₀Ne jaisi hai, jo is ke sab se qareeb noble gas hai. Chlorine atom Cl (2, 8, 7) ek electron le kar chloride ion Cl⁻ (2, 8, 8) banata hai, aur yeh bhi agli noble gas jaisa electron arrangement (tarteeb) pa leta hai. Opposite (ulte) charge wale Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ ions NaCl ke crystal mein mazboot ionic bond se jure rehte hain.
Isi qism ka bond group 1 aur 2 ke metals aur group 16 aur 17 ke elements ke beech bhi banta hai.

blocks.alt: Shells ke diagram. Sodium atom (2, 8, 1), electrons laal crosses, aur chlorine atom (2, 8, 7), electrons hare dots; mura hua arrow (teer) sodium ka bahari electron chlorine tak le jata hai. Mota arrow brackets wale ions ki taraf: sodium ion [2, 8]+ jis ka teesra shell ab khaali hai, aur chloride ion [2, 8, 8]- jis ke bahari shell mein saat dots aur liya hua ek cross hai. Neeche dabbe mein NaCl (Na+Cl-).
blocks.caption: Figure 3.1: Na aur Cl ke beech ionic bond ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.1 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 3.1 mein sodium ion [2, 8]⁺ ke teesre shell par ab bhi ek cross bana hai, jaise us ne apna bahari electron rakh liya ho. Na⁺ yeh electron chlorine ko de chuka hai, is liye us ka teesra shell khaali hota hai. Oopar wali figure mein Na⁺ ka teesra shell khaali dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Magnesium 2, 8, 2 hai aur oxygen 2, 6. Lewis theory se magnesium oxide ka ionic bond samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Magnesium group 2 ka metal hai aur us ki ionization energy kam hai; woh apne dono bahar wale electrons de kar Mg²⁺ (2, 8, neon jaisa) banta hai. Oxygen group 16 ka element hai aur us ki electron affinity zyada hai; woh dono electrons le kar O²⁻ (2, 8, neon jaisa) banti hai. Ulte charge wale ions MgO crystal mein zor se ek doosre ko khinchte hain.

items: Ionic bond: kam ionization energy wala atom electrons poore de deta hai, zyada electron affinity wala le leta hai; Na (2, 8, 1) se Na⁺ (2, 8) aur Cl (2, 8, 7) se Cl⁻ (2, 8, 8). Group 1 aur 2 aur group 16 aur 17 ke beech aisa bond banta hai.
